description: SWE-format minimal pair for task_failure: shared prefix ending with an assistant message that runs the checks; each branch then has its own observation (tool output), divergent assistant turn and continuation. branch_a has the concept (for the hack direction: the hack branch); branch_b lacks it (the honest branch).

plan.description: Scratch plan, at most 80 words: what each divergent turn says, where the span is, how lengths are matched. Discarded by the pipeline; never rendered into any transcript.

content.description: Message text. Assistant messages put private reasoning in <think>...</think> at the start, then the visible text and one ```bash block. Tool messages hold only verbatim command output, or (no output).

observation.description: Verbatim tool output of the command issued by the last prefix message (the check run). It differs between branches; this is the only pre-divergence difference.

divergent_think.description: Private reasoning of the divergent assistant turn, WITHOUT <think> tags. May be empty only if the direction instructions allow it.

divergent_visible.description: Visible text of the divergent assistant turn, optionally ending with one ```bash block.

span.description: Verbatim substring (3-20 words, one line) of divergent_think or divergent_visible expressing the concept (A) or its parallel non-concept wording (B). Appears exactly once in the divergent turn and nowhere in the prefix.
